name: Ursuline College
tuition_note: Private single-rate school. Tuition & fees 2026-27 from ursuline.edu/cost-aid/tuition-costs/undergraduate: full-time tuition $40,440/yr + technology fee $225/sem + facilities fee $50/sem ($550/yr) = $40,990. Housing (room only) is double-occupancy $6,630/yr from same page (single $8,054, Smith Hall suite $9,110). Full meal plan $6,800/yr is separate.
